questions.question_text: Which is the correct comparative form of the adjective 'beautiful'?

In the chapter 'The Lagori Champions', what is the main object used to build the tower in the game?

options: A) Watching a lot of television

questions.question_text: Identify the adverb in the sentence: The clever boy quickly solved the difficult puzzle.
What makes the peaks look stunning in 'A Journey to the Magical Mountains'?
options: A) The golden sunlight on the snow
D) The city lights shining on them
questions.answer: A) The golden sunlight on the snow

questions.question_text: What is the meaning of the idiom 'a piece of cake'?
options: D) A small part of something

questions.question_text: Identify the tense of this sentence: 'They will visit the ancient town of Maheshwar next week.'

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: Briefly explain why the character Hekko is considered special or unique in the story. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Hekko is a unique and friendly character who teaches everyone the value of kindness. His special abilities help solve problems and bring immense joy to the local children.

questions.question_text: Rewrite the following sentence in the Present Continuous tense: 'The children play Lagori in the large field.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The sentence rewritten in the Present Continuous tense is: 'The children are playing Lagori in the large field.' This shows that the action is happening right now.

questions.question_text: Mention two famous things that make the historical town of Maheshwar popular among tourists. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Maheshwar is highly popular for its grand historical fort situated along the Narmada River and its beautiful, hand-woven Maheshwari sarees featuring intricate traditional borders.

questions.question_text: Combine the two sentences using a suitable conjunction of result: 'The team practiced extremely hard. They won the championship trophy.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The team practiced extremely hard, so they won the championship trophy. Alternatively, you could say: The team practiced extremely hard; therefore, they won the championship trophy.

questions.question_text: How does regular physical exercise contribute to building a strong and capable nation? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Regular exercise keeps citizens healthy, energetic, and active, reducing illnesses. A physically and mentally fit population works harder, thinks sharper, and contributes effectively to the nation's overall progress.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are playing Lagori with your friends. Describe the teamwork and strategy required to win the game after the stone tower is broken. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: After the stone tower falls, the seeking team must coordinate very quickly. Some players distract the opposing team while others carefully stack the seven stones back in order. We must communicate clearly, run fast, and protect each other from being hit to win.

questions.question_text: Add correct punctuation to the sentence and name the two adverbs used: 'the boys ran quickly to the park they saw a huge beautifully decorated swing' [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Correctly punctuated: "The boys ran quickly to the park. They saw a huge, beautifully decorated swing." The two adverbs used in this passage are "quickly" (showing how they ran) and "beautifully" (describing how the swing was decorated for the children).

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Formal Writing

questions.question_text: Write a formal letter to your school librarian requesting them to order a new set of adventure storybooks for the Class 4 library section. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Respected Librarian, I am a student of Class 4. Our class loves reading, but we have finished reading most of the current adventure books. I kindly request you to order a new set of adventure storybooks for our section. It will greatly encourage our daily reading habits. Thanking you, Yours obediently.

questions.question_text: Describe the feeling of flying high up in a swing based on the poem 'The Swing'. How does the world look different from the highest point? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Flying high in a swing feels like having real wings, with the cool wind rushing past my face. At the highest point, the world looks small but incredibly wide. I can see clearly over the garden wall, spot winding blue rivers, and look down at the green grass below.
